URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/28/ukraines-zelenskyy-hails-good-meeting-with-trump-at-white-house

Trump-Zelenskyy White House meeting, 28 July 2026 (Al Jazeera):

Meeting lasted just over an hour in the Oval Office; second meeting between the two this month. Marks a significant relationship improvement following the contentious February 2025 encounter.

Patriot interceptors: Zelenskyy confirmed discussions about licences to produce Patriot interceptor missiles in Ukraine. Trump had approved joint production earlier in July.

Drone production: Both countries "moving closer to a deal on joint drone production." Ukraine produces 6-7 million short-range attack drones annually, outpacing the Pentagon's $1.1 billion program.

Direct quotes — Zelenskyy: "Good meeting with President Trump in the Oval Office. Thank you for all that we are doing together to protect the lives of Ukrainians and achieve peace."
Zelenskyy: "We talked with the president about licences to produce Patriot interceptor missiles in Ukraine."
Zelenskyy: "Our number-one priority is anti-ballistic defence and strategic cooperation with America."
White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt described both the Netanyahu and Zelenskyy meetings as "positive and productive."

Senate sanctions: Zelenskyy plans to meet with senators as the chamber prepares its first vote on the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctions Act targeting Russia and Iran.
